explanations.explanation: The text puts them somewhere much more out in the open, friend. Israel set up sacred pillars and Asherah poles “…on every high hill and under every green tree.” (2 Kings 17:10) The verse doesn't mention the palace at all. It's hills and trees.

explanations.answer: Along the banks of the Jordan River
explanations.explanation: The Jordan isn't named in this verse. The Israelites set up sacred pillars and Asherah poles “…on every high hill and under every green tree.” (2 Kings 17:10) Notice the word every. The writer isn't pointing at one spot.

explanations.explanation: That's the message, baker. The LORD told them through His prophets and seers, “Turn from your wicked ways and keep My commandments and statutes…” (2 Kings 17:13) It was a call to come back. The warning came before the exile, not after.
